# merge with hand_off marks the draft pull request ready, runs the notify command once, and watches the pull request until the owner merges it.
# The notify command of this script is the owner: it merges the pull request of m1 when it runs. The watch then reads MERGED and the call ends.
# The check refuses the same call when it also names a keyword of a landing.
batchsetup
replace config/projects/shop.star '    gate = "true",' '    gate = "true", notify = ["sh", "OWNER_SCRIPT"],'
replace config/projects/shop.star OWNER_SCRIPT $WORK/forge/owner.sh

exec beehave check workflow flow/handoff.star
! exec beehave check workflow flow/landing.star
stderr 'merge with .hand_off. lands nothing, so it takes no .gate_run.'

exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/handoff.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

grep -count=1 '^SetDraft 1 false$' forge/calls.log
! grep '^SetDraft 1 true' forge/calls.log
! grep '^MergePR' forge/calls.log
grep -count=1 'is ready' forge/notice.log
exists forge/merged-1
! exists forge/draft-1

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone'

-- forge/draft-1 --
-- forge/owner.sh --
folder=$(dirname "$0")
echo "$@" >> "$folder/notice.log"
date > "$folder/merged-1"
-- flow/landing.star --
def main(item):
    merge(name = "ask", base = "main", repo = "example/shop", hand_off = True, gate_run = ["true"], prs = [struct(item = "m1", head = "abc", closes = [])])
